icons.name: Ascending E
icons.concept: Heavy slab letter E whose three rungs grow in length into a rising ELO chart, capped by a gold breakthrough peak on deep brand red.

icons.name: ER Monogram Tile
icons.concept: Bold locked E+R monogram in white on a Signal Red rounded tile over Void, the heavy brand signature.

icons.name: Floating-Bar E
icons.concept: Abstract spineless E built from three free-floating ascending bars reading as a bar chart, with a tall gold breakthrough column.

icons.name: Tied Knot
icons.concept: Head-on tied gi belt knot with a white-and-red cinch, hanging tails with a red rank tip, and a striped red rank bar.

icons.name: Rank Meter
icons.concept: Belt band whose rank stripes become a climbing segmented ELO meter rising to a gold breakthrough segment.

icons.name: Diagonal Belt
icons.concept: Abstract brutalist black belt sweeping diagonally across a red field, with a striped rank tab and red leading tip.

icons.name: Tatami Arena
icons.concept: Top-down competition mat: Signal Red safety apron, gridded dark combat area, white center circle with a red live-match node.

icons.name: Closed Guard
icons.concept: Abstract closed-guard position diagram: a red wrapping frame with the crossed-ankle X lock at top, clamping the trapped white torso.

icons.name: The Match
icons.concept: Matchmaking mark of two zones (red vs white) interlocking along a dovetail void seam, each holding one engagement node.

icons.name: Delta Climb
icons.concept: Heavy stacked upward chevron-delta launching out of an ascending bar chart, gold breakthrough cap at the apex.

icons.name: Podium Tiers
icons.concept: Three ascending podium steps low-to-high with a gold-crowned Signal Red top tier carrying a knocked-out up-arrow.

icons.name: Rank Medallion
icons.concept: Bold hexagonal rank medallion holding an up-arrow over an ascending step-base, gold crown notch at the peak.

icons.name: Triangle Lock
icons.concept: Two heavy interlocking triangle frames woven over/under (Signal Red up, Terminal White down) with a central choke node, reading as a triangle choke / closed guard.

icons.name: Gi Grip
icons.concept: A solid white fist with blocky knuckles and a wrapping thumb clamping a bold diagonal Signal Red gi lapel corner to corner.

icons.name: Matched Clinch
icons.concept: Two mirror-symmetric figures (white vs red) clinched at interlocking arms across a central Void seam, a balanced, evenly-weighted heraldic pair.

icons.name: The Cut
icons.concept: A bold diagonal slash splits the tile Void-over-Signal-Red, with a white E (plus gold breakthrough step) above the cut and a mirrored knocked-out E below it.

icons.name: Planted Flag
icons.concept: A heavy white monolith planted dead-center with a gold breakthrough cap, a massive Signal Red flag blade flying off it, and a red base wedge driving it into the ground.

icons.name: Impact Diamond
icons.concept: Nested rotated Void/Red squares collapsing to a core, with two opposing force halves (Terminal White vs Gold) colliding at a hard Void seam and central impact block.
